title: feat(core): add lineWrapping config and runtime toggle
body:
## Summary

Add `lineWrapping` config option and `setLineWrapping()` runtime API to the core editor, allowing hosts to enable soft word-wrap for long lines. Mirrors CodeMirror 6's `EditorView.lineWrapping`.

## Changes

| Package | Change |
|---|---|
| `core` | Add `lineWrapping?: boolean` to `EditorConfig` |
| `core` | Add `setLineWrapping(enabled: boolean)` to `EditorAPI` |
| `core` | Implement via `Compartment` (same pattern as `themeExt`) |
| `react` | Pass `lineWrapping` prop through `<Editor />` |
| `vue` | Pass `lineWrapping` prop through `<Editor />` |
| `react`/`vue` | **Fix:** `multiCursor` prop was not being passed through the wrappers |

## Why

Most editors expose a word-wrap toggle (Obsidian, VS Code, etc.). This adds the same capability to Nexus — useful for note-taking apps where users want to see full paragraph text without horizontal scrolling.

## Tests

6 tests added in `packages/core/test/editor.test.ts`:
- Default: no wrapping
- Config `lineWrapping: true`
- `setLineWrapping(true)` at runtime
- `setLineWrapping(false)` at runtime
- `setLineWrapping` on destroyed editor (no-op)
- Toggle multiple times without state leak

## Checklist

- [x] Tests pass
- [x] `pnpm build` passes
- [x] React/Vue bindings updated in lockstep
- [x] Backward compatible (default: `false`)
- [x] AI-generated code disclosed per GOVERNANCE.md §6.2

- Uses Compartment pattern (matching theme.ts) for reconfigure
- Wire through React and Vue wrappers
- Fix multiCursor prop not being passed through React/Vue wrappers
- Add 6 tests covering config, runtime toggle, no-op on destroy, and multi-toggle
